# PC facet/pressure foundation-source audit (2026-09-15, corrective follow-up to `6533f02`)

Scope: trace, don't fix. How do fixed starters and corridor PCs actually obtain structured PC
facets/pressures/evidence today, from EXISTING approved foundation plus committed scenes — no new
provider call, no invented canon. Ends in one proposed (not implemented) smallest next step.

## 1. The two real sources, as they exist today

**Corridor** (`_pcFacetsFromBodyBible`, shipped in `6533f02`): `state.pcBodyBible` — generated by
`_generatePCBodyBible`/`_generatePCBodyBibleUncached` (`public/app.js:254888+`), tiered via the
EXISTING `_callTieredProvider('pcBodyBible', …)` call every story already makes. Two fields feed
PC-C+: `core_contradiction` and `current_crisis.immediate_fear`, with `evidence_requires`
MECHANICALLY derived (stopword-filtered content words) from `current_crisis.event` — never
invented, a pure transform of already-generated text. This is real, already-grounded, already-live.

**Fixed starter** (First Sacrifice, `STARTER_SEEDS.starter_first_sacrifice.cast[0]`,
`public/app.js:126839+`): two hand-authored `cPlusFacets` (`pc_untested_brilliance`,
`pc_fears_public_failure`), each with real `canonical_truth` and `category` — but
`possible_pressures` are PLAIN STRINGS, not the `{text, evidence_requires}` shape. `_normFacet`
normalizes a plain string to `evidence_requires: ''`, and `_cpBuildGroundedOptions`'s `if (!req)
return;` means these two facets can never ground, as shipped. **This is isolated to the PC
specifically** — verified directly: every OTHER cast member's `cPlusFacets` in the SAME seed
(Julian, Seren, the presiding Dohkar) already use the full structured `{text, evidence_requires:
'regex|regex|...'}` shape, hand-authored with real evidence rules. The gap is not "seed authoring
doesn't do structured pressures" — it is specifically "the PC's own facets were authored before
PC-C+ existed as a consumable mechanism, and never retrofitted." A single, bounded authoring gap,
not a systemic one.

## 2. A foundation source that ALREADY exists for fixed starters too, and is currently unused by them

`_generatePCBodyBible` is NOT gated on story type. It fires from THREE independent call sites —
the literary spine builder (`app.js:96393`), the CG scaffold/spine builder (`app.js:226989`), and
the general spine awaiter (`app.js:258687`) — each guarded only by `!state.pcBodyBible`, with no
`_starterId`/`is_starter_story` check anywhere in `_generatePCBodyBible` itself. `_launchStarterStory`
(`app.js:136313+`) sets `state.picks.world`/`worldSubtype`/`playerMask`/`archetype` from the
starter's OWN definition before the story ever reaches Scene 2 — so `_generatePCBodyBible`'s
archetype/wound-family steering (`_deriveDeepTrio('pc', playermask)`, world/subtype context) DOES
receive First-Sacrifice-appropriate values (Fatelands, veilwood, her actual playerMask), not
generic defaults.

**Conclusion, not yet verified against a real generation**: `state.pcBodyBible` likely already
gets generated for First Sacrifice too, from the SAME already-firing tiered call, with
world-appropriate steering — Storybound's architecture already has a second, structured,
groundable PC-facet source available for fixed starters, and `_ensurePcPortfolio` currently never
looks at it there (its fixed-starter branch returns as soon as `seedPc.cPlusFacets.length` is
non-zero, regardless of whether any of those facets can actually ground). **Open verification
question, explicitly not resolved by this audit**: whether the bible's GENERATED content for a
baked starter reads as coherent with the starter's specific, hand-authored canon (Lirael's
particular bio, wound, relationships) or as generic archetype output that happens to sit alongside
it unused today. This needs an actual sampled generation to answer honestly, which this pass does
not run (no paid calls authorized here).

## 3. What was implemented this pass (safe backward compatibility only)

`_ensurePcPortfolio`'s fixed-starter branch now marks every pressure whose `evidence_requires`
normalizes empty as `legacy_display_only: true, evidence_requires: null` (never `''`) — pure
labeling, zero behavior change (`_cpBuildGroundedOptions`'s `if (!req) return;` and
`_cpEvidenceEstablishes`'s `if (!pr.evidence_requires)` both already treat `''` and `null`
identically). PC-C+ stays exactly as absent as before for these facets — the only change is that a
legacy, structurally-never-evidenced gap is now distinguishable from an ordinary structured
pressure that simply found no matching text this scene. Proven in `_pc_baseline_portfolio_control.mjs`
CONTROL 7 (both the marking and the unchanged absence, including against a scene whose text
literally repeats the pressure's own words verbatim — still correctly absent).

## 4. Proposed smallest future foundation-issuance change (NOT implemented — Roman's call)

When a fixed starter's own seed facets exist but are structurally ungroundable
(`legacy_display_only` on every pressure of a facet, or on all facets), let `_ensurePcPortfolio`
ADDITIVELY merge in `_pcFacetsFromBodyBible(state.pcBodyBible)`'s output — ONLY when a real bible
already exists (never triggering a new generation; the existing tiered call already fires
regardless of story type per §2) — as SUPPLEMENTARY facets alongside the seed's own, never
replacing or rewriting the seed's `canonical_truth`/`category`. Concretely: her hand-authored
`pc_untested_brilliance`/`pc_fears_public_failure` stay exactly as authored (never touched — they
are Roman's canon); `pc_core_contradiction`/`pc_current_fear` from the bible become available
ALONGSIDE them, tagged with their own distinct `origin: 'pc_body_bible'` provenance so a
downstream reader can always tell seed-authored from bible-derived. No new provider call (§2), no
invented canon (mechanical transform of already-generated text, same discipline as corridor today).

**Explicitly deferred, not decided here**: whether the bible's generated content is coherent
enough with a baked starter's specific authored canon to ship as PC-C+ source material at all —
that is a product/quality judgment needing a sampled real generation to evaluate, not an
engineering default to assume. If Roman wants this built, the next step is one sampled
`_generatePCBodyBible()` run against First Sacrifice's real `picks`/`playerMask` state, read
blind for coherence, before wiring the merge.
